mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals tightening monetary policy, which leads to higher borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 shows sustained growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate signals economic weakness, leading to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 70% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals reduced economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts signals increased consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where HOUST increases > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls signals economic weakness, leading to reduced corporate earnings and investor sentiment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines > 100k.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2% and CPI inflation is rising, the real interest rate is negative, which signals a potential stagflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth is strong and consumer spending (proxied by retail and food services sales) is increasing, it signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 2% and RSAFS increases > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 growth > 2% and RSAFS increases > 1%.
